_evidence: esi record of 0x00529ee2 (menu value handler over 0x539944/0x539a13 like 0x529dab): the value cell pointer +0xe is read through 0x539944 (width selector byte +0xd & 3) and, when u8 0x81d1eb is 0xff, the result is also stored through the second target pointer +0x36 by 0x539a13 - both real 8-byte buffers (dword store at most), never random. The rest of the 0x40-byte record is random (bit 2 of +0x1e set in about half the cases). Global part as rec_00529dab: 0x81d1eb is 0xff in half the cases.
